message_clarity.instructions: Does the commit message explain what changed and why? 1 = vague (e.g. 'fix', 'wip', 'update'), 10 = clearly says what changed and why.

message_format.instructions: Does the commit message follow a conventional format? 1 = no format, 10 = conventional prefix (e.g. 'feat: ...', 'fix(api): ...') and subject under 72 characters.

message_accuracy.instructions: Does the commit message match the files that were actually changed? 1 = message describes something unrelated to the changed files (e.g. 'fix typo in README' but only src/auth.py changed), 10 = message accurately describes the changed files.

focus.instructions: Do the changed files belong to a single concern? 1 = unrelated files across many areas, 10 = all files belong to one feature or fix.
